description: Returns confirmed signatures for transactions involving an address backwards in time from the provided signature or most recent confirmed block.

parameters.name: account_address
parameters.description: The account address encoded as base-58 string

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: (Optional) The configuration object with the following fields:

sub_parameters.name: limit
sub_parameters.description: The maximum number of transaction signatures to return (between 1 and 1000). The default value is 1000

sub_parameters.name: before
sub_parameters.description: Start searching backward from this transaction signature. If not provided, the search starts from the top of the highest max confirmed block

sub_parameters.name: until
sub_parameters.description: Searches until this transaction signature, if found before limit reached

sub_parameters.name: commitment
sub_parameters.description: The level of commitment required for the query. The options include:

sub_parameters.name: minContextSlot
sub_parameters.description: The minimum slot at which the request can be evaluated

result.description: A JSON object with the following fields:

result.blockTime.description: The estimated production time, as Unix timestamp (seconds since the Unix epoch). Null if not available

result.confirmationStatus.description: The transaction's cluster confirmation status. The status can either be processed, confirmed, or finalized

result.err.description: Error code if the transaction failed or null if the transaction succeeds

result.memo.description: The memo associated with the transaction and null if no memo is present

result.signature.description: The base58-encoded signature of the transaction

result.slot.description: The slot number in which the transaction was confirmed
